observations: A rounded, bulky figure fills the frame against a flat amber-yellow background; the form is built from layered horizontal bands of white, grey, and black wrapping the head and shoulders.
Two solid black circular lenses sit side by side in the upper face, each framed by a thin drawn ring; a wide curved line below them reads as a grin.

The mouth area shows a row of small, tightly packed white shapes rendered with scratchy overlapping lines; a dark curved outline frames them above and below, but no large open cavity is clearly visible.
reading: Bands of white and grey wrap a bulbous figure so completely that the underlying form is hard to locate — the wrapping is the surface. Against the flat amber field, two black disc lenses and a wide grin give the figure a fixed, unreadable expression. The smile shows a packed row of teeth but offers no warmth; the opaque lenses block any return gaze. The mood reads as cheerful and unsettling at once.
